newsitem.title: USA: Kent to issue 2.2 mln shrs for acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Kent to issue 2.2 mln shrs for acquisitions.

text.p: Kent Electronics Corp said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire two specialty wire and cable redistribution companies, Futronix Corporation of Houston and Wire and Cable Specialties Corporation of Atlanta.
The agreement calls for the exchange of 2.2 million shares of Kent common stock for all of the common stock equivalents of both companies, Kent said.
The estimated value of the transaction is about $65 million, including the assumption of about $20 million in debt that Kent plans to retire upon completion, the company said.
The combined sales of Futronix and Wire and Cable Specialties was over $35 million for the six months ended June 30.
